column1: # SP-B02-4 — an allowlist per job, not per node: target, method, size limit, derived from the
# authority (K-04). This file is the derivation, and decisions/gates-and-the-outbox.md §3 is the
# ruling that makes it one: until AP-6.2 mints a Biscuit through the lease, the authority a job
# carries is the level the channel decided (SP-T01-4), and the level is what this table is keyed by.
# Three properties are ruled with it and checked against it by acceptance/k03-outbox.sh:
#   default deny     a level not named here reaches nothing — so a level added to
#                    contract/schema.sql's authority_level enum and forgotten here fails closed
#   per job          the lookup happens per order at every single forward, never per node
#   names, not addresses   the pod sends a name and the gate resolves it (SP-B02-3); a target that
#                    is already an address is refused, because an address is what a resolver
#                    produces and a pod has none
# The levels are contract/schema.sql's `authority_level`, widest last. A level permits the targets
# of every level below it — the ordering is the only place that relation lives, and the program
# reads it from the order of the rows here.
# targets      comma-separated host names. One wildcard is permitted, at the front: `*.example.org`.
#              Never an address and never a bare `*`: a gate whose allowlist matches everything is
#              not an allowlist, it is a route.
# methods      comma-separated HTTP methods. GET alone is a read-only job.
# size_limit   the largest response the gate will pass back, in bytes. A limit rather than none,
#              because SP-B02-4 names it beside target and method: a job permitted to read a host
#              is not thereby permitted to drag a disk image through the gate.
# When AP-6.2 grants the first lease, the allowlist comes from the token's `targets` block instead
# and this table describes nothing. The lookup keyed by order_id does not change; only what fills it.
level
public
linked
confidential
